name: 35806 · Huntsville, AL
findings: ZIP 35806 (Huntsville) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35806 (Huntsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 35806 (Huntsville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
